summary: Computes or manages normal and tangent vectors for incoming triangle or quad geometry, writing N and optionally T attributes on point, vertex, or primitive classes.

key_concepts: Normal POP computes, removes, or preserves normal and tangent attributes for triangle or quad geometry.
Normals can be point, vertex, or primitive attributes, with weighting, technique, and angle controls determining how shared surfaces are shaded.
Tangent generation depends on position, normal, and texture-coordinate attributes, so it belongs after topology and texture-coordinate setup.
common_gotchas: Normal and tangent calculations assume triangle or quad context.
Max primitives per point must be sufficient because GPU allocation needs predetermined sizes.
Existing normals or tangents can be left alone, recomputed, removed, warned, or errored depending on action settings.
